_about: Hand-labelled retrieval set for agents/retriever.py. Each query is one a UI Copy Writer brief would actually emit; expect_file is the note that must appear in the top k. Labels are at file granularity on purpose — see evaluate() in retriever.py. Pinned notes (the contract, the law, the budgets, the term table) are never retrieval targets because they are injected on every call.
